DefaultOperator.Definition: The {c:color-blue keyword}default{/c} keyword operator produces the default value for a given type.

NameOfOperator.Definition: A unary keyword operator that returns the identifier name of the specified type as a string.

SizeOfOperator.Definition: A unary keyword operator that returns the compile-time size, in bytes, of a specified type.

TypeOfOperator.Definition: A unary keyword operator that produces a {c:color-gray keyword}System.Type{/c} object representing a specified compile-time type.
